notes: BOOTSTRAP set: 3 frozen real/reconstructed cases. It is NOT a benchmark and cannot support generalisation claims; the spec still requires 20-50 dev cases plus an isolated held-out set.
Annotations are per (memory id, rendered role) with labels answer|context|noise|repeat|stale-or-conflict.
Expected answer families freeze both a reference statement and the equivalent memory ids; answer coverage requires an ANCHOR display (neighbour-only never counts).

The two negative cases are kept exactly as the user reported them: their noise bodies are still displayed by the current serve path, and the annotations were NOT relaxed to manufacture an improvement.
These fixtures are frozen: do not regenerate them from the live DB or from current ranks. A new case gets a new id and its own provenance.

snapshotConfig is the capture-time serve config, frozen with the fixtures. The runner never reads the live gateway config; an explicit --snapshot-config JSON override is recorded as configSource=override.

Provenance honesty: quality-negative is captured verbatim (stored block served unchanged). research-negative and model-preference are REPLAYED: their served blocks are re-rendered from the frozen pool by the real adapter. For model-preference the serve-time query was not captured, so currentQuery is the turn-212 user text used as a stand-in (not the recorded input of that serve).

P1 shadow extension: liveCapture/liveAnnotations/liveExpectedAnswerFamilies freeze the live boundary-path output captured in Temp/opencode/session-recall-live-seed.json; the shadow runner never requests the Gateway. The capture printed only 6-char pointer tails, so live annotation ids are those tails (snapshot annotations keep full ids). liveCapture.query is the capture's own input when it differs from the case's currentQuery. A live capture with no memory/T1 pointer in its block (a bare <topic-recall> shell) is NOT a served memory block.

Live timing honesty: the seed recorded no wall-clock time, so capturedAt is frozen as an ordering token (2026-11-19T09:04:00.000Z). That is 42 min after quality-negative's snapshot build and 32 min after research-negative's, both past the 10-min snapshot TTL. The live arm is therefore a LATER live call for the same query text, NOT a same-turn counterfactual: it says 'what the live path returned later', not 'what it would have returned on that turn'.

topicState is the audited CURRENT TopicState of ses_e7444718cffeVJ3eJOTAReq8F0 (revision 4, updatedAt 2026-11-18T10:05:23.261Z), frozen once and replayed against all three 2026-11-19 cases.
